column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE MEDIATION BOARDS ACT, NO. 72 OF 1988
BE it  enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Mediation  Boards

2.
Section  7  of  the  Mediation  Boards  Act,  No.  72  of
1988 (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is
hereby amended in paragraph (b) of the proviso to subsection
(1) thereof, by the substitution for the words "that dispute."of
